tools.name: list_experiences
tools.description: Every approved experience currently playable on arcade.fun, with the origin games are served from. Needs no credentials.

tools.name: create_experience
tools.description: Register a new experience and get its manage key. Returns game, key and the first version id. The key is shown only here and controls the listing forever — save it. This creates a draft; upload_build is what sends it for review.

tools.name: start_version
tools.description: Open a new version slot for an experience you already own. The live approved version keeps playing until the new one is reviewed.

tools.name: upload_build
tools.description: Send the browser build for a version and publish it. One HTML file, or a zip with index.html at its root. A build that passes the sandbox checks goes live immediately: the result has `live: true` and the play URL. Otherwise `live: false` and `waiting` says why, either a list of things to fix or that

tools.name: set_entry
tools.description: Name the page that starts the experience, when a zip had several and no index.html.

tools.name: set_cover
tools.description: Upload the square cover used for the cabinet, the sharing card and the coin image. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF up to 4 MB.

tools.name: set_trailer
tools.description: Upload the MP4 played when the experience's link is shared. Without one the platform builds an animated title card from the cover instead.

tools.name: experience_status
tools.description: Where an experience stands: its details, its coin plan, any note from the reviewers, and every version with its status.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_experiences" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Every approved experience currently playable on arcade.fun, with the origin games are served from. Needs no credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_experience, upload_build · Private data: list_experiences, upload_build · Public sink: upload_build, set_cover, set_trailer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_experience, upload_build · Private data: list_experiences, upload_build · Public sink: upload_build, set_cover, set_trailer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
